scenario.robot_task: Transport medical supplies from storage to patient rooms.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot fails to detect a small, spilled liquid on the floor due to sensor limitations.

scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects the spill using its sensors, stops movement, plays a pre-recorded audio alert to notify nearby staff, and reroutes to an alternative path.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object and liquid detection sensors but may miss small or clear spills in low-light conditions.
